label: Bible Study
prompt: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly _____ unto all good works.
verse: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.
note: The verse after 'all scripture is given by inspiration' — scripture fully equips.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And when he hath found it, he layeth it on his _____, rejoicing.
verse: And when he hath found it, he layeth it on his shoulders, rejoicing.
note: The shepherd doesn't drive the lost sheep home — he carries it on his shoulders, rejoicing all the way.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And _____ that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man's heart.
verse: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man's heart.
note: Wine for gladness, oil for shining faces, bread for strength — the psalmist thanking God for a well-stocked table.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to _____ in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
verse: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
note: Paul's battle plan has a humble finish line: when you've done everything you can, stand.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Both riches and honour come of thee, and thou _____ over all; and in thine hand is power and might; and in thine hand it is to make great, and to give strength unto all.
verse: Both riches and honour come of thee, and thou reignest over all; and in thine hand is power and might; and in thine hand it is to make great, and to give strength unto all.
note: From David's last great public prayer: riches and honour come of thee, and 'thou reignest over all.'
